title: Adjournment motion on land use, green spaces and the Serangoon River Forest bus depot
what_it_is: An Adjournment Motion in which Dennis Tan called for a rethink of how development and green space trade-offs are assessed, and Minister of State Alvin Tan responded on land use planning and the Serangoon River Forest bus depot.
why_it_matters: The record states the planned bus depot at the southern part of the Serangoon area is intended to improve public transport services for residents and bring economic development and jobs closer to homes in Hougang, Sengkang, Defu and Paya Lebar Air Base. LTA has agreed to measures during construction, including hoarding the work site and conducting checks for birds' nests and other wildlife before site clearance. The Minister said the Government will not revisit the matter.

key_points.point: Dennis Tan said he was speaking on a matter of increasing urgency and public concern.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: I speak today on a matter of increasing urgency and public concern.

key_points.point: Dennis Tan said there is a need to rethink how trade-offs between development and preserving existing green spaces are assessed and justified.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: The need to fundamentally rethink how we assess and justify the trade-offs between essential development and the preservation of our existing green spaces.

key_points.point: Dennis Tan said land scarcity is real but not neutral or value free.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: land scarcity in Singapore is real, but it is not neutral and it is not value free.

key_points.point: Dennis Tan said works to develop a bus depot in the middle of part of the Serangoon River Forest between Tampines Road and Buangkok East Drive began a few months ago.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: Works to develop a bus depot in the middle of the part of the forest between Tampines Road and Buangkok East Drive began a few months ago

key_points.point: Dennis Tan said no environmental impact assessment or baseline biodiversity study was required before the Government decided on and commenced the bus depot construction.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: no environmental impact assessment (EIA) or baseline biodiversity study was required before the Government decided on and commence the bus depot construction.

key_points.point: Dennis Tan said the brownfield label gave a permanent exemption from the duty to conduct an EIA or baseline biodiversity study regardless of vegetation age and density.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: Thus, the label "brownfield" gave us a permanent exemption from the duty to conduct an EIA or a baseline biodiversity study, regardless of the vegetation's age and density.

key_points.point: Dennis Tan proposed that the brownfield classification must no longer provide an automatic exemption from environmental studies before development.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: The brownfield classification must no longer provide an automatic exemption from environmental studies before development.

key_points.point: Dennis Tan asked the Government to review and consider relocating the bus depot to the heavy vehicle park at Tampines Road.
key_points.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
key_points.quote: Please review and consider relocating the bus depot to the heavy vehicle park at Tampines Road

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said his objectives and Dennis Tan's objectives are the same.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: I wanted to say that our objectives are the same.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said he disagrees with how Dennis Tan characterised the Government's approach over the years.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: I disagree with how he has characterised the approach we have been taking all these years

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the Government takes a long-term and careful approach to planning limited land for diverse needs.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: The Government takes a long-term and very careful approach when planning how we use our limited land to support the diverse needs and aspirations of generations of Singaporeans

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the Government is redeveloping brownfield sites and activating underused spaces such as viaducts and carpark rooftops.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: we are redeveloping brownfield sites, such as golf courses, industrial areas, and also activating underused spaces, such as via ducts and carpark rooftops.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said more than 7,800 hectares of green spaces have been safeguarded for nature reserves, nature parks and other green spaces.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: Today, we have safeguarded more than 7,800 hectares of green spaces for our nature reserves, nature parks and other green spaces

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said that by 2030 every household will be within a 10-minute walk of a park.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: By 2030, every household will be within a 10-minute walk of a park.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said that by 2030 the Government aims to restore and enhance 80 hectares of forest, marine and coastal habitats and establish 300 kilometres of nature ways.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: By 2030, we aim to restore and enhance 80 hectares of forest, marine and coastal habitats as well as to establish 300 kilometres of nature ways.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said an EIA study is required if there is potentially significant environmental impact from a development.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: if there is potentially significant environmental impact from the development, we require an EIA study to assess in greater detail

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said it is not true that brownfield sites automatically do not require an EIA.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: it is not true that brownfield sites automatically do not require EIA.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the Serangoon area has been zoned for industrial use since 1998.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: this area has been zoned for industrial use since 1998.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said a Gazette Notice was published on 1 December 2023 for rezoning to B2 transport facilities for the bus depot.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: on 1 December 2023, a Gazette Notice was published for rezoning to B2 to transport facilities for this bus depot.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the planned bus depot at the southern part of the area is intended to improve public transport services for residents.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: The planned bus depot, which the Member raised, at the southern part of this area is intended to improve public transport services for residents.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the area was previously a municipal waste landfill known as the Tampines Tipping Ground.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: The area was previously a municipal waste landfill known as the Tampines Tipping Ground.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said technical agencies assessed the site is not a sensitive nature area and the bus depot's environmental impact is limited, so an environmental study was not required.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: Technical agencies have assessed that this site is not a sensitive nature area and the environmental impact of the bus depot is limited. Hence, an environmental study was not required.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the vegetation is regeneration of the last 10 to 15 years, comprising young exotic dominated secondary forests, scrubland, grassland and ponds.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: The vegetation on the site is a result of regeneration of the last 10 to 15 years, comprising young exotic dominated secondary forests, scrubland, grassland and ponds.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the Government will not revisit the matter.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: We will not revisit the matter.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said LTA has agreed to put in place necessary measures during construction.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: LTA has agreed to put in place necessary measures during the construction.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said the measures include conducting checks for birds' nests and other wildlife before site clearance.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: conducting checks for birds' nests and other wildlife before site clearance.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said agencies are reviewing potential development plans for the remaining areas along the eastern bank of Sungei Serangoon.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: agencies are reviewing potential development plans for the remaining areas along the eastern bank of Sungei Serangoon.

key_points.point: Alvin Tan said ultimately the Government must take a view and make a decision.
key_points.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan)
key_points.quote: we must take a view and make a decision.

what_happens_next: The Minister said the Government will not revisit the matter; agencies are reviewing potential development plans for the remaining areas along the eastern bank of Sungei Serangoon; LTA has agreed to construction measures. Parliament adjourned at 7.18 pm.
not_said: What specific construction measures has LTA agreed to, and over what period will they apply?
What will the agencies' review of potential development plans for the remaining areas along the eastern bank of Sungei Serangoon cover?
How will the Government measure whether the planned bus depot improves public transport services for residents?
What is the timeline for the progressive development of the site for industrial use?
How will the 2030 targets for restoring 80 hectares of habitats and establishing 300 kilometres of nature ways be implemented?
